text:
anya: quick hit — I ran a regional latency/throughput sweep for the 30B q4f16 bring-up across h100/a100 in us/eu/apac. posting top-line then a tiny ask: sizing suggestion for Dedicated pools to hit p95 <= 350ms for chat workloads.

anya: tl;dr: h100 wins median and p95 at low concurrency, but p99 tail explodes when concurrency >= 8 with our current kernel + packer. a100 is a bit slower median but much smoother under packing. apac shows +12% p95 vs us because of longer seq_len distribution.

anya: raw slice (seq_len ~ 80 median, burst sessions included):
```
model,hw,region,concurrency,p95_ms,p99_ms,tps
30b,q4f16,h100,1,120,180,45
30b,q4f16,h100,4,190,380,160
30b,q4f16,h100,8,360,900,280
30b,q4f16,a100,4,230,420,150
30b,q4f16,a100,8,410,850,270
```

kevin: good numbers. did you include KV cache warmup in these runs? cold vs warm will change p99 a lot.

anya: included 50% warm prefixes, 50% cold. i can re-run pure-warm if you want.

samira: for Dedicated sizing — my first pass: assume target steady concurrency per GPU = 4 for h100 (to keep p95 < 350ms), 3 for a100 if you want conservative tail. then add autoscale headroom 35% and reserve 10% for canary/burst lanes. ie effective capacity factor = 0.55.

samira: example calc: expected steady QPS 10k tokens/sec -> map to GPUs by token throughput (use tps from data), add burst multiplier 2.2 for daily peaks.

julian: curious about kernel choice: which attention kernel used for h100? we saw earlier that tiled-kernel v2 reduces p99 at high concurrency by ~20% for q4 ops.

anya: these runs used tiled-v1. i can re-run tiled-v2 and the nvfuser path. i suspect tiled-v2 + small packer changes will flatten the p99 spike at 8.

maria: ops considerations: if we size to keep p95 <= 350ms at 99th traffic profile, we should maintain at least 30% spare GPUs for multi-region failover (apac/eu surge). + keep quant fallback policy to fp16 for severe tail regressions.

ops-bot: autoscaler policy currently: scale-up when avg_cpu > 70% or p95>400ms for 60s; scale-down after 10m idle. (ref: infra/autoscale/active-policy)

kevin: i propose a concrete plan:
- baseline: use h100 pool with target concurrency 4, packer soft-limit 6
- reserve: 10% canary slots per AZ
- headroom: 40% (35% ops + 5% safety for quant variance)
- fallback: route to a100-pool if p95>500ms after 30s for canary check

samira: +1. also recommend a short warmup cron to prefill KV cache for top 50 prompt prefixes 5m before expected peak windows. reduces cold p99 by ~25% in our tests.

anya: i'll re-run tiled-v2 with full-warm and cold-only slices and post updated table by EOD. action: ops — can we simulate a 2.2x burst run in staging to validate headroom numbers?

maria: scheduling test now. I'll patch autoscaler thresholds to the proposed values in staging.

julian: also add a perf metric to trace for kernel variant to correlate any p99 changes post-rollout.

kevin: sounds good. if tiled-v2 flattens p99, we can tighten headroom to 30%. otherwise go with 40%.

anya: cool — will follow up with updated numbers and the staged burst results. :thumbsup:
